changelog:
• On-Demand hero is now a discovery picker — a random film from the BBC 100 Greatest Films of the 21st Century, with its trailer playing muted behind the copy
• Hero shows IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic scores, plus Watched it / Watchlist / Next suggestion
• New My List tab: watch-later and already-watched shelves

• Player: double-tap the left or right third to seek ±10s
• Player: after ~4.5s idle the chrome hides and the embed returns to fullscreen
